jobs.title: Director Product Marketing, Network Security
jobs.description:
Welcome to the future of cloud networking and security!

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

The Role

We are hiring a  Director of Product Marketing, Network Security to lead and scale our product marketing function across Cato’s portfolio. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for portfolio strategy, positioning and messaging, product launches, and people leadership.

You will shape how Cato’s products and capabilities are brought to market, ensuring clear differentiation, compelling customer value, and strong alignment across the business. You will partner closely with Product, Sales, Engineering, and Executive Leadership while building and leading a world-class team of product marketing experts.

Responsibilities

Own Product Marketing Strategy

- Define and execute the product marketing strategy in alignment with company priorities.

- Serve as the senior product marketing voice across leadership, Product, Sales, and go-to-market teams.

- Drive positioning, messaging, launches, sales support, competitive differentiation, and market expertise across Cato’s portfolio.

Lead a High-Performance PMM Team

- Hire, mentor, and develop Product Marketing Managers.

- Set priorities, standards, and operating frameworks for messaging, launches, content, and enablement.

- Build strong collaboration across Product, Sales, Partners, Events, and other cross-functional teams.

- Ensure clear, differentiated messaging that communicates Cato’s business and technical value .

Shape Thought Leadership

- Guide the development of high-impact content, including blogs, white papers, webinars, and executive perspectives.

- Translate technical innovation into customer value, business outcomes, and market leadership.

Requirements

Experience

- 10+ years of Product Marketing experience, with 4+ years in a leadership or director-level role

- Strong background in cybersecurity (Network/SSE/Zero Trust)

- Proven ability to translate complex technology into compelling, high-impact narratives

- Comfortable create & present to executives, customers, and large audiences

- Ability to create clear execution plans, respond fast, and multi-task

Data-Driven and Market-Informed

- Use insights, analytics, and market intelligence to guide messaging, launches, and strategic decisions

Exceptional Cross-Functional Leader

- Trusted partner to Product, Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive teams

- Known for building alignment, clarity, and momentum

Thrives in Hyper-Growth Environments

- Comfortable juggling competing priorities in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial culture

- Bias toward action, ownership, and results

Magnetic Leadership Presence

- Charismatic, confident, and credible

- Brings energy, conviction, and thought leadership to every interaction

Education

- Engineering degree or equivalent hands-on technical experience

A reasonable estimate of the salary for this role, at the time of posting, is $250,000 - $290,000. Cato operates from a high place of trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skill set, experience, location, training, and certifications.

As an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status.

jobs.title: GTM Product Marketing Manager EMEA
jobs.description:

Cato Networks is seeking a high-impact GTM Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to accelerate sales execution and improve conversion rates primarily across the EMEA region. In this role, you will serve as a regional product marketing subject matter expert (SME), working closely with sales leadership, sales engineers, and customer success teams to help sellers win faster and more effectively.

This  role is ideal for a strategic operator who thrives at the intersection of product messaging, technical knowledge, GTM strategy, and seller success. If you are passionate about converting product capabilities into compelling customer value wins, this is the opportunity for you.

Roles & Responsibilities

- Accelerate Pipeline . Turn use cases and cross-sell motions into focused programs that help the field identify, engage, and progress the right opportunities.

- Bring Launches to Life . Take new capabilities from launch to field execution, making sure sellers understand what’s new, why customers should care, and how to take it to market.

- GTM Enablement. Provide sales teams with the messaging, plays, training, and real-world insights they need to have stronger customer conversations and execute consistently.

What You’ll Do

- Drive pipeline velocity . Partner with Demand Gen, Sales, and RevOps to build targeted GTM motions around priority use cases, and cross-sell opportunities. Develop sharper discovery and qualification tools and help identify the accounts where we have the strongest opportunity to win.

- Own launch activation . Turn launches into field-ready GTM programs. Develop regional activation content and programs that help sellers quickly understand the opportunity and start customer conversations.

- Build GTM plays that sellers will use . Create playbooks with talk tracks, discovery questions, objection handling, competitive positioning, and clear customer value. Reinforce them through hands-on regional training and ongoing field engagement.

- Stay close to real deals . Join Deal Reg and Pod calls, review Gong conversations, and work directly with sellers to understand what is working, where deals are getting stuck, and what the field needs next. Turn those insights into better messaging, content, and GTM programs.

- Create a continuous field feedback loop . Bring what you learn from customers and sellers back to Product Marketing and the broader GTM organization, helping us continuously improve how we position, launch, and sell.

- Measure what matters . Track seller adoption, Stage 1 to Stage 2 conversion, win rates, and other GTM signals to understand what is working. Use the data to improve programs. Why This Role Matters

- Connect strategy to execution. Turn product marketing strategy into GTM programs the field can execute and customers respond to.

- Influence the deals that matter. Bring positioning, competitive insights, and customer value directly into active sales opportunities.Bring the voice of the field back into GTM . Use real customer and seller feedback to continuously sharpen messaging, plays, and programs. Make a measurable revenue impact . Improve pipeline progression and win rates by focusing GTM resources on the conversations and opportunities with the greatest potential.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Sales Strategy, or GTM roles within cybersecurity.

- Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, and Value Selling.

- Strong domain expertise in SASE, SD-WAN, Zero Trust, and Cloud Security.

- Analytical thinker comfortable with funnel analysis, win/loss data, and usage metrics.

- Ability to influence across teams and executive stakeholders.

- Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth, and cross-functional environments.

Why Join Cato Networks?

- Make an impact where growth is happening . Join Cato as we expand how enterprises adopt networking, security, and AI capabilities through a single SASE platform.

- Own outcomes . This is a hands-on GTM role with a direct connection to pipeline, field execution, launches, and revenue.

- Work across the business . Partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Product, RevOps, and regional teams to turn strategy into execution.

- Help shape how we go to market . Bring insights from sellers and customers back into our GTM strategy, then turn those insights into programs the field can use.

- Take on a highly visible role . Your work will show up in how we launch, how our sellers engage customers, and how effectively we turn market opportunities into growth.

- Pace. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity platforms in the market.

#LI-JD1

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cato Networks is building Product-Led Growth capabilities that complement its established enterprise, direct-sales, and partner-led business.

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own product-led customer journeys across Cato’s target markets, with a particular focus on SMB while also improving how larger enterprise customers discover, evaluate, activate, adopt, and expand Cato.

For SMB customers, this may include highly self-service journeys from signup and onboarding through value realization, purchase, and expansion. For larger enterprises, PLG will complement the sales-led motion by helping customers experience value sooner, adopt more effectively, identify expansion opportunities, and create stronger product-qualified demand.

This is an individual-contributor role. You will own measurable customer and business outcomes, working directly with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Channel, Customer Success, and Business Operations.

What You’ll Do

- Own and improve the end-to-end PLG journey across relevant customer segments: discover → evaluate → activate → experience value → adopt → convert → retain → expand .

- Define segment-specific product-led journeys for SMB and enterprise customers, balancing self-service, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted experiences.

- For SMB, drive simple self-service onboarding, guided configuration, sensible defaults, in-product education, packaging, upgrade paths, and purchase experiences.

- For enterprise customers, identify ways to accelerate evaluation, activation, time-to-value, adoption, product-qualified demand, and expansion.

- Define the key activation and “aha” moments for different customer segments, and improve time-to-first-value and unassisted or assisted activation.

- Own product requirements related to trials, free experiences where relevant, packaging, entitlements, upgrade paths, pricing UX, purchase flows, and conversion triggers.

- Define, instrument, and monitor PLG metrics, including activation, time-to-first-value, product adoption, conversion, product-qualified opportunities, retention, and expansion.

- Use product analytics, customer research, funnel analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, test hypotheses, and continuously improve outcomes.

- Partner with Sales, Marketing, Channel, Customer Success, Finance, and Business Operations to create seamless product-led, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted journeys.

- Identify product-usage and behavioral signals that can trigger contextual recommendations, expansion opportunities, partner engagement, or sales outreach.

What You Bring

- 5+ years of Product Management experience  in B2B SaaS.

- Deep understanding of Product-Led Growth , including SaaS metrics, freemium and trial models, and PLG-driven customer journeys.

- Strong experience defining and delivering  user-facing product experiences , with a solid understanding of UI/UX principles.

- Background or strong familiarity with  networking and security technologies is an Advantage .

- Understanding of the  SMB networking and security market , including customer needs and the services these customers typically purchase.

- Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
